app.title: Cloudflare/Security-Audit-Skill
app.author: donk8r
app.description: Security audit skill for the CodeQL platform, automating common audit tasks and providing actionable recommendations.
proposed_tests: Clone the repo and run the provided CodeQL queries against a sample repo
Verify that the skill flags known vulnerabilities (e.g., use of hardcoded credentials)
Measure the time taken to analyze a repository of ~10k lines of code
Check that the generated audit report includes severity and remediation links
